Next county report due October 15: need device counts, class attendance since July, and two participant quotes.
County contact for the grant is the Digital Inclusion desk; reports go through the same portal as the application (watch the 5 MB limit).

County grant awarded: $8,000, restricted to devices, hotspots and class materials. No staff wages from this money.
Decided to hire a part-time coordinator in the fall, funded from general donations (the county grant can't pay wages).
